text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated tail latency and token drop errors for tenant TesseraCorp in dedicated-pool dc-eu-2. 75% of requests hitting queue stall. Paging on-call

paige: acknow, I'm on it. seeing the alert in Sentry and the Console.

paige: @raj can you join? looks like their load test ramped and queued requests started spiking.

raj: on my way. pulling scheduler metrics now.

raj: console shows scheduler queue length for tessera-tenant up to 18k pending, avg wait 3.6s, p99 generation latency 1.8s -> token drop errors in logs.

sylvie: customer SRE (tessera) pinged support, they say this started after a new bulk ingest job at ~09:12 UTC.

paige: ok we need a quick mitigation: options: 1) throttle that tenant route, 2) bump dedicated pool capacity, 3) adjust scheduler knobs (max_batch_tokens / max_batch_size) to reduce per-request wait. prefer no deploy.

raj: agree. quickest low-risk is tuning scheduler params for that tenant: reduce max_batch_tokens and enable aggressive queue smoothing. We'll target `max_batch_tokens` drop from 4096 -> 1536 and lower `batch_wait_ms` from 30 -> 15.

kevin: what's downside? smaller batches -> higher per-token cost but should reduce tail latency. good for quick customer impact reduction.

paige: get the exact command in the doc. we use redctl for on-host config changes, right?

raj: yes. command (exec in admin-target for dc-eu-2):

```
redctl set-scheduler --tenant tessera --pool dc-eu-2 --max_batch_tokens 1536 --batch_wait_ms 15 --grace_period 45s
```

raj: this updates runtime config without restart. it propagates via control plane and picks up within ~10s per node.

ops-bot: NOTE: Planned scheduler config change requested by raj. Change ID cid-7892. Applying to 12 runtime nodes.

paige: executing now. I'll run the command and watch metrics.

paige: ran the command. change id cid-7892 accepted. starting phased rollout

raj: I'm subscribing to the tenant queue topic. watching pending count.

kevin: I'll open a temporary rate-limit on the tenant route to prevent new spikes while change rolls out. `redctl route set-rate --tenant tessera --rps 2000`

paige: rate-limit in place. console shows incoming rps dropped from 9k -> 2k. pending queue immediately started draining.

sylvie: tessera-sre: thanks — we're seeing fewer 5xx's and their test harness shows reduced dropped tokens.

tessera-sre: Confirmed on our side. p95 latency down from 2.1s -> 0.6s. test job still running but much healthier. thanks. :tada:

raj: now slowly lifting rate-limit to avoid bounce. I'll increment by 500 rps every 2 minutes.

ops-bot: Change cid-7892 rollout status: nodes updated 4/12, 8/12, 12/12. All nodes reported success.

raj: all nodes picked up new scheduler knobs. queue length stabilized at ~200-400. token drop errors cleared in logs.

paige: great. i'm going to revert the temporary rps cap once we confirm 10 minutes of stable metrics. monitoring window starts now.

kevin: noted. also created a short-lived canary route to route <5% traffic to a fallback model variant for safety.

sylvie: any customer-visible change besides latency improvement? billing will see slight increase per-token due to smaller batches — flag in case Tessera asks.

tessera-sre: acknowledged, we can absorb the cost for the run. appreciate the quick fix.

paige: next steps: - keep the scheduler knobs as soft mitigation for next 24h - run job-level throttling guidance in support doc - follow-up retro and add a runbook entry for tenant-burst tuning referencing these knobs.

raj: opened internal ticket INF-4521 to track longer-term: evaluate adaptive batch sizing for tenants with frequent bursts; maybe auto-apply per-tenant `max_batch_tokens` based on moving-window load.

paige: assigning handoff to oncall-next: @sylvie you're on deck at 10:30 UTC, please keep monitoring until the job completes and then remove the rps cap.

sylvie: got it. will watch for another 30m then remove the cap. set reminder.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1783014000 to remove rps cap for tessera.

kevin: small ask: can we add `max_batch_tokens` and `batch_wait_ms` visibility per-tenant to the Console? would help quicker diagnosis.

paige: agreed — include in postmortem action items.

tessera-sre: update: job finished; no further errors after the knobs change. we'll run a trimmed re-ingest tomorrow and provide load profile.

paige: thanks everyone. I'll close the page in 1h if stable. filing a brief incident note now.

raj: note for the postmortem: exact log signatures were `kvcache: token_drop` and `scheduler: batch_timeout` at p99. include the `redctl` commands used above.

sylvie: adding runbook entry: `If dedicated-tenant queue stalls, try lowering max_batch_tokens to 1536, reduce batch_wait_ms, and apply temporary rps cap while rolling out.`

paige: closing on-call thread, handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
